title: Expander graphs are not conscious without coherent world modeling

statements.text: The expander graph objection is handled by treating integrated information as necessary but not sufficient. Hierarchical expander graphs could even implement predictive processing and turbo coding, but they will not be conscious unless their function enables coherently integrated world modeling.

sources.quote: Yet such objections to IIT’s validity can be readily handled by considering integrated information to be necessary, but not sufficient for consciousness
Nonetheless IWMT states that such systems will not be conscious unless their functionality enables coherently integrated world modeling
